title: 2 Hour Private Historical Boat Tour Of Lake Tahoe
includes: Captain Fee | Per USCG Law For Groups Over 6 People Only | 100 USD Per Hour Due Upon Arrival (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness

Please Read - Additional Cost For Groups Of 7+ Passengers: Per US Coast Guard regulation, for groups of 7 or more passengers, the cost of the captain cannot be included in the charter fee and is not included in the amount paid at the time of booking. An additional 100 USD per hour is due upon arrival and must be paid directly to the captain via cash, Venmo or Zelle. This is only for groups of 7 or more passengers. For groups of 6 or less all costs are included at the time of booking.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience the timeless beauty of Lake Tahoe like never before with our Historical Boat Tour. This unique excursion invites you to explore the storied shores of Lake Tahoe while uncovering fascinating history and breathtaking views. From the grandeur of Vikingsholm Castle to the charm of the Valhalla Boat House, this tour blends history, nature, and adventure into an unforgettable two-hour experience.
